crossRefs.note: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you…
Yahweh do so to Jonathan, and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you, and…

translations.web: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”
translations.bsb: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, so I can ask about you. And if I find out anything, I will tell you.”
translations.kjv: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.
translations.asv: and I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and if I see aught, I will tell thee.
